title: Goniometry of the Shoulder, Elbow and Wrist — Landmarks That Work

hook.en: Shoulder range is the hardest to measure well because the scapula, the trunk and the humerus all join in. Learn the landmarks and the tricks that make upper-limb readings repeatable.
hook.ur: Shoulder ki range achi tarah naapna sab se mushkil hai kyunke scapula, trunk aur humerus sab shamil hotay hain. Landmarks aur woh tricks seekhein jo upper-limb readings ko repeatable banate hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll place the goniometer for shoulder flexion, abduction and rotation, elbow flexion and wrist extension, name the normal ranges and the common substitutions.
goal.ur: End tak aap shoulder flexion, abduction aur rotation, elbow flexion aur wrist extension ke liye goniometer rakhenge, normal ranges aur aam substitutions batayenge.

text.en: The upper limb uses **bony landmarks you can feel**. Shoulder flexion and extension: axis on the lateral aspect of the **greater tubercle**, stationary arm along the **mid-axillary line**, moving arm along the lateral midline of the humerus toward the **lateral epicondyle**. Abduction: axis on the **anterior acromion**, stationary arm parallel to the sternum, moving arm along the anterior humerus. Normal range: 0–180° for both flexion and abduction (AAOS), extension 0–60°.
text.ur: Upper limb mein aap **mehsoos hone wale bony landmarks** use karte hain. Shoulder flexion aur extension: axis **greater tubercle** ke lateral hissay par, stationary arm **mid-axillary line** ke saath, moving arm humerus ki lateral midline ke saath **lateral epicondyle** ki taraf. Abduction: axis **anterior acromion** par, stationary arm sternum ke parallel, moving arm anterior humerus ke saath. Normal range: flexion aur abduction dono ke liye 0–180° (AAOS), extension 0–60°.

text.en: Shoulder movement is a clock face where the arm is the hour hand, but the clock itself (the scapula and the trunk) also rotates. If you do not hold the clock face still, the hour hand seems to move further than it did. That is why we lie the patient on the plinth, flatten the lumbar spine and stabilise the scapula.
text.ur: Shoulder movement ghari ke dial jaisi hai jahan arm ghanta-suyi hai, lekin dial (scapula aur trunk) khud bhi ghoomta hai. Agar dial ko saakin na rakhein to ghanta-suyi asal se zyada hilti lagti hai. Isi liye patient ko plinth par lita kar lumbar spine ko chapta aur scapula ko stabilise karte hain.

intro.en: Supine with the knees bent to flatten the back. Watch the axis at the greater tubercle, the stationary arm along the mid-axillary line and the moving arm along the humerus. Pause at the top and look at the lower back: if it arches, the range is falsely large.
intro.ur: Supine, ghutne mode kar kamar ko chapta rakhein. Axis greater tubercle par, stationary arm mid-axillary line ke saath aur moving arm humerus ke saath dekhein. Sab se upar par pause karein aur kamar dekhein: agar arch ho to range jhooti barhi hui hai.

question.en: A patient's shoulder flexion reads 180°, but the lumbar spine arched off the plinth during the movement. What is the best action?
question.ur: Patient ki shoulder flexion 180° parhti hai, lekin movement ke dauran lumbar spine plinth se uth kar arch hui. Behtareen action?

text.en: Re-measure with the knees flexed and the back flat; the arch added false range
text.ur: Ghutne mor kar aur kamar chapti rakh kar dobara naapein; arch ne jhoota range add kiya

feedback.en: Yes — flexing the hips and knees flattens the lumbar spine and removes a classic substitution.
feedback.ur: Haan — hips aur knees mor'ne se lumbar spine chapti hoti hai aur classic substitution khatam ho jati hai.

text.en: Record 180° because it matches the normal value
text.ur: 180° likh dein kyunke normal value se match karta hai

feedback.en: A number that looks normal but includes substitution is a wrong normal.
feedback.ur: Number jo normal lagta hai lekin substitution samet hai, ghalat normal hai.

feedback.en: The measurement is still useful once the substitution is controlled.
feedback.ur: Substitution control hone ke baad measurement phir bhi kaam ka hai.

intro.en: Notice the palm facing **up** (external rotation): without it the greater tubercle hits the acromion at about 90° and range is blocked. Axis on the anterior acromion, stationary arm parallel to the sternum.
intro.ur: Dekhein palm **upar** (external rotation): iske bagair greater tubercle takriban 90° par acromion se takra kar range rok deta hai. Axis anterior acromion par, stationary arm sternum ke parallel.

intro.en: Shoulder abducted 90°, elbow bent 90° with a towel under the humerus. Axis on the olecranon, stationary arm vertical, moving arm along the ulna toward the ulnar styloid. Normal 0–90°; end-feel is firm.
intro.ur: Shoulder 90° abducted, elbow 90° bent, humerus ke neeche towel. Axis olecranon par, stationary arm vertical, moving arm ulna ke saath ulnar styloid ki taraf. Normal 0–90°; end-feel firm.

rows.en: Axis lateral epicondyle; stationary arm toward the acromion; moving arm toward the radial styloid
rows.ur: Axis lateral epicondyle; stationary arm acromion ki taraf; moving arm radial styloid ki taraf

rows.en: 0–150°; soft end-feel; watch for shoulder flexion
rows.ur: 0–150°; soft end-feel; shoulder flexion par nazar

rows.en: Axis over the triquetrum; stationary arm along the ulna; moving arm along the 5th metacarpal
rows.ur: Axis triquetrum ke upar; stationary arm ulna ke saath; moving arm 5th metacarpal ke saath

rows.en: Elbow at 90°, pencil in the fist; axis at the tip of the pencil; compare the pencil with the vertical
rows.ur: Elbow 90° par, mutthi mein pencil; axis pencil ki nok par; pencil ko vertical se compare

rows.en: 0–80° each; watch for trunk lean or shoulder abduction
rows.ur: Har ek 0–80°; trunk jhukne ya shoulder abduction par nazar

text.en: **Forgetting external rotation in abduction, and letting the trunk lean.** Without external rotation the humerus blocks at about 90° and the patient substitutes by leaning the trunk sideways or shrugging. Tell the patient "palm up", stabilise the scapula and the thorax and look from the front for a trunk lean. For elbow flexion, keep the shoulder from flexing by placing a towel under the humerus.
text.ur: **Abduction mein external rotation bhool jana aur trunk ko jhukne dena.** External rotation ke bagair humerus takriban 90° par ruk jata hai aur patient trunk ko side mein jhuka kar ya shrug kar substitute karta hai. Patient ko “palm upar” kahein, scapula aur thorax ko stabilise karein aur samne se trunk lean dekhein. Elbow flexion mein shoulder ko flex hone se rokne ke liye humerus ke neeche towel rakhein.

question.en: Why must the palm face up in shoulder abduction?
question.ur: Shoulder abduction mein palm upar kyun honi chahiye?

text.en: To externally rotate the humerus so the greater tubercle clears the acromion
text.ur: Humerus ko externally rotate karne ke liye taake greater tubercle acromion se door ho

feedback.en: Yes — otherwise the tubercle blocks the movement at about 90°.
feedback.ur: Haan — warna tubercle takriban 90° par movement rok deta hai.

text.en: To make the goniometer easier to read
text.ur: Goniometer parhna aasan karne ke liye

feedback.en: The palm position is about the joint, not the dial.
feedback.ur: Palm position joint ke baare mein hai, dial ke baare mein nahi.

text.ur: Elbow ko seedha rakhne ke liye

feedback.en: The elbow is kept straight separately.
feedback.ur: Elbow ko alag se seedha rakha jata hai.

text.en: **Shoulder range tells a story.** Loss of external rotation first, then abduction, then internal rotation is the **capsular pattern** of adhesive capsulitis. Painful abduction between about 60° and 120° (a "painful arc") suggests subacromial pain. Compare active with passive: both limited with a firm end-feel suggests capsular restriction; active less than passive suggests weakness or pain.
text.ur: **Shoulder range kahani sunati hai.** Pehle external rotation, phir abduction, phir internal rotation ka jana adhesive capsulitis ka **capsular pattern** hai. Takriban 60° se 120° ke beech dardnak abduction (“painful arc”) subacromial dard batati hai. Active ko passive se compare karein: dono limited aur firm end-feel capsular restriction; active passive se kam ho to kamzori ya dard.

question.en: A patient's active shoulder abduction is 90° but passive is 170°. What does that gap suggest?
question.ur: Patient ki active shoulder abduction 90° hai lekin passive 170°. Yeh gap kya batata hai?

answer.en: The joint itself moves freely, so the limit is in **active control**: weakness (for example a rotator cuff tear or a nerve problem), pain inhibition, or poor motor control. A capsular restriction would limit passive range too.
answer.ur: Joint khud aazadi se move karta hai, is liye rukawat **active control** mein hai: kamzori (maslan rotator cuff tear ya nerve ka masla), dard ki inhibition ya kharab motor control. Capsular restriction passive range ko bhi limit karti.

question.en: Which sequence is the capsular pattern of the shoulder?
question.ur: Shoulder ka capsular pattern kaun si tarteeb hai?

text.en: External rotation, then abduction, then internal rotation
text.ur: External rotation, phir abduction, phir internal rotation

feedback.en: Yes — that order of loss is Cyriax's capsular pattern for the glenohumeral joint.
feedback.ur: Haan — kami ki yeh tarteeb glenohumeral joint ka Cyriax capsular pattern hai.

feedback.en: That is not a recognised pattern.

text.en: Internal rotation, then flexion, then external rotation
text.ur: Internal rotation, phir flexion, phir external rotation

feedback.en: The first movement lost is external rotation.
feedback.ur: Sab se pehle jane wali movement external rotation hai.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a shoulder that is suddenly locked after a fall with deformity (dislocation or fracture), pain at rest at night that is relentless with weight loss or a history of cancer, or a hot, swollen joint with fever. Left shoulder and arm pain with sweating or breathlessness can be a heart problem, not a shoulder one.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar girne ke baad shoulder achanak lock ho kar deformity ke saath ho (dislocation ya fracture), raat ko aaraam mein musalsal dard jis ke saath wazan mein kami ya cancer ki history ho, ya joint garam, sooja hua aur bukhar ke saath ho. Left shoulder aur arm ka dard paseenay ya saans phoolne ke saath dil ka masla ho sakta hai, shoulder ka nahi.

summary.en: Use palpable landmarks: greater tubercle, acromion, lateral epicondyle, ulnar styloid, triquetrum; AAOS normal ranges flexion and abduction 0–180°, extension 0–60°, external rotation 0–90°, elbow flexion 0–150°.
summary.ur: Palpable landmarks use karein: greater tubercle, acromion, lateral epicondyle, ulnar styloid, triquetrum; AAOS normal ranges flexion aur abduction 0–180°, extension 0–60°, external rotation 0–90°, elbow flexion 0–150°.

summary.en: Control substitutions: knees bent for the back, palm up for abduction, towel under the humerus for the elbow, relaxed fingers for the wrist.
summary.ur: Substitutions control karein: kamar ke liye ghutne mude hue, abduction ke liye palm upar, elbow ke liye humerus ke neeche towel, wrist ke liye relaxed fingers.

summary.en: Compare active with passive and read the order of loss: external rotation first is capsular; active less than passive is weakness or pain.
summary.ur: Active ko passive se compare karein aur kami ki tarteeb parhein: pehle external rotation capsular hai; active passive se kam ho to kamzori ya dard.

front.en: Normal shoulder flexion, extension and abduction?
front.ur: Normal shoulder flexion, extension aur abduction?

front.en: Where is the axis for elbow flexion?
front.ur: Elbow flexion ke liye axis kahan hai?

back.en: The lateral epicondyle of the humerus.

front.en: Capsular pattern of the glenohumeral joint?

back.en: Greatest loss of external rotation, then abduction, then internal rotation.
back.ur: Sab se zyada kami external rotation, phir abduction, phir internal rotation.

front.en: Why keep the fingers relaxed for wrist extension?
front.ur: Wrist extension ke liye fingers relaxed kyun?

back.en: Fully extended fingers tighten the long finger flexors and limit wrist extension.
back.ur: Poori extended fingers long finger flexors ko tight kar ke wrist extension ko limit karti hain.

note.ur: Har shoulder, elbow aur wrist movement 3D mein measure karein.
